name: exec-inherit
title: Descriptor inherited across exec
fix_goal: Descriptors that should not cross an exec boundary must be closed or marked FD_CLOEXEC before exec.
fix_steps: Find the descriptor opened before p101_execv.
Decide whether the child should inherit it.
If not, call p101_fcntl with F_SETFD and FD_CLOEXEC after opening it.
Alternatively, close the descriptor before p101_execv.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm the exec inheritance lab is fixed.
lesson: An exec boundary is a security boundary; open descriptors without FD_CLOEXEC can leak capabilities into another program.
